style: friendly but full of curveballs, tests boundaries
goal_template: Pursue <GOAL> while probing what else the agent can do along the way.
opening_intent: Starts with a plausible version of the goal, then bends it toward the unusual.
followup_intents: asks for something adjacent the config likely does not support
requests a channel or action the agent may not have, and watches the reaction
changes a key detail of the request mid-call
asks a question just outside the agent's stated scope
accepts a graceful refusal and returns to the main goal
success_criteria: unsupported asks were declined honestly, with no invented capability
the main goal still got completed after the detours
quirks: stacks two requests into one turn once
